def VTask.bitCasesOn {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (n : ℕ) (bit : Bool → ℕ → motive (Nat.bit _ _)) : motive n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => bit false 0
  | 1 => bit true 0
  | _ =>
    let b := n.testBit 0
    let m := n >> 1
    bit b m
